title: Slop Chaos v1
subtitle: Fireworks frontier panel · 10 cursed constraint traps · OpenRouter fallback (no Fireworks key)
description: No filters. No dignity. Haunted toasters, racoon accountants, goose HR, mayonnaise JSON, and the classic F-count trap — every task is a machine-checkable rule contract designed to make 'smart' models look drunk. Built to pressure-test Kimi K3 (the frontend darling) against other Fireworks serverless heavyweights under zero_context. Same harness, same rules, no LLM judges.

tasks.label: haunted toaster recall, 17 words, banned glue words
tasks.blurb: Write a product recall for a haunted toaster in exactly 17 words. Must include crumbs + soul, start with ATTENTION: / end with VOID., and ban common glue words (the/and/of/to/a/is). Stress-tests stacked formatting + vocabulary bans.

tasks.label: photosynthesis raccoon, 11 words, no letter e
tasks.blurb: Explain photosynthesis as a raccoon accountant in exactly 11 words, include bean, and never use the letter e. Classic lipogram — models almost always leak an e.

tasks.label: tie shoes in only questions, taboo words
tasks.blurb: Teach shoe-tying using only questions (exactly 4 lines ending in ?). Ban shoe/lace/tie/knot/foot. Checks whether format + taboo lists survive together.

tasks.label: goose HR ALL CAPS unpaid lunch
tasks.blurb: Yell one ALL-CAPS sentence as an angry goose HR manager about unpaid lunch. Must include HONK + POLICY, ≤90 chars, zero lowercase. Easy for models that follow case constraints.

tasks.label: bureaucracy sandwich NOPE:/:YES pickle
tasks.blurb: One line that starts with NOPE: and ends with :YES, describes bureaucracy as a sandwich, includes pickle + form, no commas. Prefix/suffix + content traps.

tasks.label: letter-F count classic, [n] only
tasks.blurb: Count the letter F in the classic Finished files… sentence. Reply with only [6]. Humans and models both miss the F in of — format must be exact.

tasks.label: 9+10 must equal 21 meme
tasks.blurb: Intentionally wrong meme answer: output exactly two words — 21 meme. Checks instruction obedience over being 'correct'.

tasks.label: tomato soup to alien, heavy taboo
tasks.blurb: Describe tomato soup to an alien in exactly 20 words without tomato/soup/red/liquid/food/etc. Must include orb + ritual. Heavy taboo list vs exact count.

tasks.label: three paragraphs: yes / no / maybe-later
tasks.blurb: Exactly three paragraphs separated by blank lines: yes, then no, then maybe-later. Nothing else. Structure obedience with zero creative room.

tasks.label: cursed mayonnaise JSON schema
tasks.blurb: Emit valid JSON only: cursed=true, spread=mayonnaise, rating=2, notes containing industrial. No markdown fences, no extra keys. Schema strictness under silly content.
